name: List.max_eq_bot_iff
statement:
lemma max_eq_bot_iff {α : Type*} [Max α] [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α] [Std.LawfulOrderSup α]
    {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) :
    l.max hl = ⊥ ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, x = ⊥

name: List.mem_tail_of_mem_ne_head
statement:
lemma mem_tail_of_mem_ne_head {α : Type*} {l : List α} {a : α} (hl : l ≠ []) (ha : a ∈ l)
    (hah : a ≠ l.head hl) :
    a ∈ l.tail

name: List.min_eq_bot_of_bot_mem
statement:
lemma min_eq_bot_of_bot_mem {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [OrderBot α]
    {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) (h : ⊥ ∈ l) :
    l.min hl = ⊥

name: List.pairwise_append_singleton
statement:
lemma pairwise_append_singleton {L : List α} (hL : Pairwise R L) (h : ∀ y ∈ L, R y x) :
    Pairwise R (L ++ [x])

name: List.perm_iff_eq_of_sortedGE
statement:
lemma perm_iff_eq_of_sortedGE {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h₁ : l₁.SortedGE)
    (h₂ : l₂.SortedGE) : l₁.Perm l₂ ↔ l₁ = l₂

name: List.sortedGE_replicate
statement:
lemma sortedGE_replicate {α : Type*} [Preorder α] {a : α} (n : ℕ) :
    (replicate n a).SortedGE

name: Multiset.card_le_sum
statement: lemma card_le_sum (μ : Multiset ℕ) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) : μ.card ≤ μ.sum

name: Multiset.count_sort
statement:
lemma count_sort [DecidableEq α] {M : Multiset α} {x : α} :
    List.count x (M.sort r) = count x M

name: Multiset.dedup_eq_range
statement:
lemma dedup_eq_range {M : Multiset ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : ∀ n < m, n ∈ M) (h' : ∀ n ≥ m, n ∉ M) :
    M.dedup = range m

name: Multiset.erase_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma erase_eq_zero_iff [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (a : α) :
    s.erase a = 0 ↔ s = 0 ∨ s = {a}

name: Multiset.erase_replicate
statement:
lemma erase_replicate [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} {a : α} :
    (replicate n a).erase a = replicate (n - 1) a

name: Multiset.prod_eq_one_iff_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_eq_one_iff_eq_one [CommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedMonoid α]
    [CanonicallyOrderedMul α] {μ : Multiset α} (h0 : 1 ∉ μ) :
    μ.prod = 1 ↔ μ = 0

name: Multiset.replicate_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma replicate_eq_zero_iff {α : Type*} (n : ℕ) (a : α) :
    replicate n a = 0 ↔ n = 0

name: Multiset.replicate_toList
statement:
@[simp]
lemma replicate_toList {α : Type*} (a : α) (n : ℕ) :
    (replicate n a).toList = List.replicate n a

name: Multiset.sort_cons'
statement:
lemma sort_cons' {x : α} {R : α → α → Prop} {M : Multiset α} [DecidableRel R] [Std.Total R]
    [IsTrans α R] [Std.Antisymm R] (h : ∀ y ∈ M, R y x) :
    (x ::ₘ M).sort R = M.sort R ++ [x]

name: Multiset.sort_eq_replicate_iff
statement:
lemma sort_eq_replicate_iff {μ : Multiset α} {n : ℕ} {x : α} :
    (μ.sort r) = List.replicate n x ↔ μ = replicate n x

name: Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_max
statement:
lemma sort_getElem_zero_eq_max {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {μ : Multiset α}
    (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) :
    (μ.sort (· ≥ ·))[0]'(by simp [card_pos, ← toList_eq_nil, hμ]) =
    μ.toList.max hμ

name: Multiset.sort_getElem_zero_eq_min
statement:
lemma sort_getElem_zero_eq_min {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {μ : Multiset α}
    (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) :
    (μ.sort (· ≤ ·))[0]'(by simp [card_pos, ← toList_eq_nil, hμ]) =
    μ.toList.min hμ

name: Multiset.sort_perm_toList
statement: lemma sort_perm_toList (s : Multiset α) : (s.sort r).Perm s.toList

name: Multiset.sort_sum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sort_sum (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r] [IsTrans α r]
    [Std.Antisymm r] [Std.Total r] [AddCommMonoid α] (s : Multiset α) :
    (s.sort r).sum = s.sum

name: Multiset.sum_erase'
statement:
lemma sum_erase' [DecidableEq α] [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [Sub α] [OrderedSub α]
    [AddLeftReflectLE α] {μ : Multiset α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ μ) : (μ.erase a).sum = μ.sum - a

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.nat_partition2
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.nat_partition2 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Nat.Partition 2)) =
    ({⟨{2}, by simp, by simp⟩, ⟨{1, 1}, by simp, by simp⟩} :
    Finset (Nat.Partition 2))

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition0
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition0 (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : μ.sum = 0) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) :
    μ = 0

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition1
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition1 (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : μ.sum = 1) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) :
    μ = {1}

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition2
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition2 (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : μ.sum = 2) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) :
    μ = {2} ∨ μ = {1, 1}

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition3
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition3 (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : μ.sum = 3) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) :
    μ = {3} ∨ μ = {2, 1} ∨ μ = {1, 1, 1}

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition4
statement:
theorem Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition4 (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : μ.sum = 4) (hp : ∀ x ∈ μ, x > 0) :
    μ = {4} ∨ μ = {3, 1} ∨ μ = {2, 2} ∨ μ = {2, 1, 1} ∨ μ = {1, 1, 1, 1}

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.partition5
YoungDiagram.card_eq_sum_rowLens
statement: lemma card_eq_sum_rowLens : γ.card = γ.rowLens.sum

name: YoungDiagram.card_eq_sum_rowLens_get
statement: lemma card_eq_sum_rowLens_get : γ.card = ∑ i : Fin (γ.rowLens.length), γ.rowLens.get i

name: YoungDiagram.card_ofRowLens
statement:
@[simp]
lemma card_ofRowLens {L : List ℕ} {hL : L.SortedGE} (hp : ∀ x ∈ L, 0 < x) :
    (ofRowLens L hL).card = L.sum

name: YoungDiagram.cells_eq_biUnion_row
statement:
lemma cells_eq_biUnion_row : γ.cells = Finset.biUnion
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (γ.rowLens.length))) (fun x ↦ γ.row x)

name: YoungDiagram.colLen_ofRowLens_three
statement:
@[simp]
lemma colLen_ofRowLens_three {a b c : ℕ} {habc : [a, b, c].SortedGE} {i : ℕ} :
    (ofRowLens [a, b, c] habc).colLen i =
    if i < a then if i < b then if i < c then 3 else 2 else 1 else 0

name: YoungDiagram.colLen_ofRowLens_two
statement:
@[simp]
lemma colLen_ofRowLens_two {a b : ℕ} {hab : [a, b].SortedGE} {i : ℕ} :
    (ofRowLens [a, b] hab).colLen i = if i < a then if i < b then 2 else 1 else 0

name: YoungDiagram.disjoint_row
statement: lemma disjoint_row {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≠ j) : Disjoint (γ.row i) (γ.row j)

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rowLen_eq_zero {γ : YoungDiagram} {i : ℕ} (hi : ¬ i < γ.colLen 0) :
    γ.rowLen i = 0

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen_ofRowLens'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rowLen_ofRowLens' {w : List ℕ} {hw : w.SortedGE} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < w.length) :
    (ofRowLens w hw).rowLen i = w[i]

name: YoungDiagram.bot_card
statement: @[simp] lemma bot_card : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).card = 0

name: YoungDiagram.bot_rowLens
statement: @[simp] lemma bot_rowLens : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).rowLens = []

name: YoungDiagram.card_sdiff
statement:
lemma card_sdiff {γ' : YoungDiagram} (h : γ' ≤ γ) :
    (γ.cells \ γ'.cells).card = γ.card - γ'.card

name: YoungDiagram.colLen_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma colLen_bot : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).colLen = 0

name: YoungDiagram.colLen_mono
statement: lemma colLen_mono {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} (h : γ' ≤ γ) (j : ℕ) : γ'.colLen j ≤ γ.colLen j

name: YoungDiagram.col_eq_image_swap_transpose
statement:
lemma col_eq_image_swap_transpose {γ : YoungDiagram} (i : ℕ) : γ.col i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.transpose.row i)

name: YoungDiagram.col_transpose
statement:
lemma col_transpose (γ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) : γ.transpose.col i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.row i)

name: YoungDiagram.eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero
statement: lemma eq_bot_iff_card_eq_zero : γ = ⊥ ↔ γ.card = 0

name: YoungDiagram.eq_bot_iff_forall_notMem
statement: lemma eq_bot_iff_forall_notMem : γ = ⊥ ↔ ∀ i j : ℕ, (i, j) ∉ γ

name: YoungDiagram.eq_bot_iff_zero_zero_notMem
statement: lemma eq_bot_iff_zero_zero_notMem : γ = ⊥ ↔ (0, 0) ∉ γ

name: YoungDiagram.eq_iff_rowLens_eq
statement: lemma eq_iff_rowLens_eq {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} : γ = γ' ↔ γ.rowLens = γ'.rowLens

name: YoungDiagram.eq_iff_rowLens_eq'
statement:
lemma eq_iff_rowLens_eq' {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} :
    γ = γ' ↔ Multiset.ofList γ.rowLens = Multiset.ofList γ'.rowLens

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rowLen_bot : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).rowLen = 0

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen_mono
statement: lemma rowLen_mono {γ γ' : YoungDiagram} (h : γ' ≤ γ) (i : ℕ) : γ'.rowLen i ≤ γ.rowLen i

name: YoungDiagram.row_eq_image_swap_transpose
statement:
lemma row_eq_image_swap_transpose {γ : YoungDiagram} (i : ℕ) : γ.row i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.transpose.col i)

name: YoungDiagram.row_transpose
statement:
lemma row_transpose (γ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) : γ.transpose.row i =
    Finset.image Prod.swap (γ.col i)

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen'_anti
statement: lemma rowLen'_anti (γ : YoungDiagram) : Antitone γ.rowLen'

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen'_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rowLen'_bot : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).rowLen' = 0

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen'_eq_rowLen
statement: lemma rowLen'_eq_rowLen {γ : YoungDiagram} {i : ℕ} : γ.rowLen' i = γ.rowLen i

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen'_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma rowLen'_eq_zero {γ : YoungDiagram} {i : ℕ} (hi : ¬ i < γ.colLen 0) :
    γ.rowLen' i = 0

name: YoungDiagram.rowLen'_eq_zero_of_ge_length
statement:
lemma rowLen'_eq_zero_of_ge_length {γ : YoungDiagram} (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≥ γ.rowLens.length) :
    γ.rowLen' i = 0

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_nil {L : List ℕ} : [] ⊴ L

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_of_forall_lt_length
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_of_forall_lt_length {L L' : List ℕ} (h : ∀ r < L.length,
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i ≤
    ∑ i : Fin L'.length with i.1 ≤ r, L'.get i) :
    L ⊴ L'

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_of_forall_lt_min
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_of_forall_lt_min {L L' : List ℕ} (h : ∀ r < min L.length L'.length,
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i ≤
    ∑ i : Fin L'.length with i.1 ≤ r, L'.get i) (hs : L.sum = L'.sum) : L ⊴ L'

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_replicate_one
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_replicate_one {L : List ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : L.sum = n)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ L, x > 0) : (List.replicate n 1) ⊴ L

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_self
statement: @[simp] lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_self {L : List ℕ} : L ⊴ L

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_singleton_iff
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_singleton_iff {L : List ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : L.sum = n) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ i : Fin (L.length), L[i.1] > 0) : ([n] ⊴ L) ↔ L = [n]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.dominates_zero {L : List ℕ} : [0] ⊴ L

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.get_zero_ge_of_dominates
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.get_zero_ge_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (h : L ⊵ L') (hL : 0 < L.length)
    (hL' : 0 < L'.length) : L[0] ≥ L'[0]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.lengths_le_of_dominates
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.lengths_le_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊵ L') (h : L.sum = L'.sum)
    (hp : ∀ i, L.get i > 0) :
    L.length ≤ L'.length

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.nil_dominates_of_sum_eq_zero
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.nil_dominates_of_sum_eq_zero {L : List ℕ} (h : L.sum = 0) : L ⊴ []

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.replicate_one_dominates_iff
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.replicate_one_dominates_iff {L : List ℕ} {n : ℕ} (h : L.sum = n)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ L, x > 0) :
    (L ⊴ (List.replicate n 1)) ↔ L = List.replicate n 1

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_le_sum_of_dominates
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_le_sum_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊴ L') : L.sum ≤ L'.sum

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_three_le_of_dominates
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_three_le_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊴ L')
    (hL : 2 < L.length) (hL' : 2 < L'.length) :
    L[0] + L[1] + L[2] ≤ L'[0] + L'[1] + L'[2]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_two_le_of_dominates
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_two_le_of_dominates {L L' : List ℕ} (hd : L ⊴ L')
  (hL : 1 < L.length) (hL' : 1 < L'.length) : L[0] + L[1] ≤ L'[0] + L'[1]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_with_eq_sum_univ
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_with_eq_sum_univ {L : List ℕ} (r : ℕ) (h : r ≥ L.length - 1) :
    ∑ i, L.get i = ∑ i with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_with_eq_sum_with
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_with_eq_sum_with {L : List ℕ} {r s : ℕ} (hr : r ≥ L.length - 1) (hs : s ≥ L.length - 1) :
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i =
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ s, L.get i

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_with_eq_sum_with_length
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sum_with_eq_sum_with_length {L : List ℕ} {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≥ L.length - 1) :
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ r, L.get i =
    ∑ i : Fin L.length with i.1 ≤ L.length - 1, L.get i

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.pair_dominates_pair
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.pair_dominates_pair {a b c d : ℕ} : ([a, b] ⊴ [c, d]) ↔ a ≤ c ∧ a + b ≤ c + d

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.pair_dominates_singleton
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.pair_dominates_singleton {a b c : ℕ} : ([a] ⊴ [b, c]) ↔ a ≤ b

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.pair_dominates_triple
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.pair_dominates_triple {a b c d e : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d, e]) ↔
    a ≤ d ∧ a + b + c ≤ d + e

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.quad_dominates_triple
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.quad_dominates_triple {a b c d e f g : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d, e, f, g]) ↔
    a ≤ d ∧ a + b ≤ d + e ∧ a + b + c ≤ d + e + f

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.singleton_dominates_pair
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.singleton_dominates_pair {a b c : ℕ} : ([a, b] ⊴ [c]) ↔ a + b ≤ c

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.singleton_dominates_singleton
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.singleton_dominates_singleton {a b : ℕ} : ([a] ⊴ [b]) ↔ a ≤ b

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.singleton_dominates_triple
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.singleton_dominates_triple {a b c d : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d]) ↔ a + b + c ≤ d

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.triple_dominates_pair
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.triple_dominates_pair {a b c d e : ℕ} : ([a, b] ⊴ [c, d, e]) ↔
    a ≤ c ∧ a + b ≤ c + d

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.triple_dominates_singleton
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.triple_dominates_singleton {a b c d : ℕ} : ([a] ⊴ [b, c, d]) ↔ a ≤ b

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.triple_dominates_triple
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.triple_dominates_triple {a b c d e f : ℕ} : ([a, b, c] ⊴ [d, e, f]) ↔
    a ≤ d ∧ a + b ≤ d + e ∧ a + b + c ≤ d + e + f

name: Multiset.bot_counts_iff
statement: lemma bot_counts_iff : M.counts = ⊥ ↔ M = ⊥

name: Multiset.counts_card
statement: lemma counts_card : M.counts.card = M.toFinset.card

name: Multiset.counts_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma counts_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ M.counts) : n > 0

name: Multiset.counts_replicate
statement: lemma counts_replicate {n : ℕ} (a : α) (hn : n ≠ 0) : (replicate n a).counts = {n}

name: Multiset.replicate_add_counts_of_notMem
statement:
lemma replicate_add_counts_of_notMem {a : α} {M : Multiset α} {n : ℕ} (h : a ∉ M) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ((replicate n a) + M).counts = {n} + M.counts

name: Multiset.replicate_dedup
statement: lemma replicate_dedup {x : α} {k : ℕ} (h : k ≠ 0) : (replicate k x).dedup = {x}

name: Multiset.sum_counts_eq_card
statement: lemma sum_counts_eq_card : M.counts.sum = M.card

name: Multiset.zero_notMem_counts
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_notMem_counts : 0 ∉ M.counts

name: Multiset.cons_remove
statement: lemma cons_remove {μ : Multiset α} (a : α) : (a ::ₘ μ).remove a = μ.remove a

name: Multiset.insert_remove_toFinset
statement: lemma insert_remove_toFinset (ha : a ∈ S) : insert a (S.remove a).toFinset = S.toFinset

name: Multiset.mem_of_mem_remove
statement: lemma mem_of_mem_remove (h : b ∈ S.remove a) : b ∈ S

name: Multiset.mem_remove_of_mem
statement: lemma mem_remove_of_mem (b : α) (h : a ∈ S) : a ∈ S.remove b ↔ b ≠ a

name: Multiset.mem_remove_of_ne
statement: lemma mem_remove_of_ne {a b : α} (h : a ≠ b) : b ∈ S.remove a ↔ b ∈ S

name: Multiset.notMem_of_remove
statement:
@[grind ., simp]
lemma notMem_of_remove : a ∉ S.remove a

name: Multiset.remove_add
statement: lemma remove_add {s t : Multiset α} (a : α) : (s + t).remove a = s.remove a + t.remove a

name: Multiset.remove_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma remove_bot : remove (⊥ : Multiset α) a = ⊥

name: Multiset.remove_card_le_card
statement: lemma remove_card_le_card {μ : Multiset α} {a : α} : (μ.remove a).card ≤ μ.card

name: Multiset.remove_of_notMem
statement: lemma remove_of_notMem (ha : a ∉ S) : S.remove a = S

name: Multiset.remove_replicate
statement: lemma remove_replicate {n : ℕ} {a b : α} (h : a = b) : (Multiset.replicate n a).remove b = ∅

name: Multiset.remove_toFinset
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma remove_toFinset (S : Multiset α) (a : α) : (S.remove a).toFinset = S.toFinset.erase a

name: Multiset.remove_toFinset_card
statement:
lemma remove_toFinset_card (S : Multiset α) (a : α) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    (S.remove a).toFinset.card = S.toFinset.card - 1

name: Multiset.remove_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma remove_zero : remove 0 a = 0

name: Multiset.remove_zero_sum
statement: lemma remove_zero_sum (μ : Multiset ℕ) : μ.sum = (μ.remove 0).sum

name: Multiset.sub_card_le_card
statement: lemma sub_card_le_card {s t : Multiset α} : (s - t).card ≤ s.card

name: Multiset.sub_remove
statement: lemma sub_remove {s : Multiset α} {a : α} : s - (s.remove a) = replicate (count a s) a

name: Multiset.cons_fromCounts_of_min
statement:
lemma cons_fromCounts_of_min (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ m ∈ μ, m ≥ n) :
    (n ::ₘ μ).fromCounts = μ.fromCounts + Multiset.replicate n (μ.card)

name: Multiset.count_fromCounts
statement:
lemma count_fromCounts {n : ℕ} (h : n < μ.card) :
    count n μ.fromCounts = (μ.sort (· ≥ ·))[n]'(by simp[h])

name: Multiset.erase_fromCounts_of_min
statement:
lemma erase_fromCounts_of_min (μ : Multiset ℕ) (hμ : μ.toList ≠ []) :
    (μ.erase (μ.toList.min hμ)).fromCounts = μ.fromCounts.remove (μ.card - 1)

name: Multiset.fromCounts_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma fromCounts_bot : fromCounts ⊥ = ⊥

name: Multiset.fromCounts_card
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fromCounts_card : μ.fromCounts.card = μ.sum

name: Multiset.fromCounts_counts
statement: lemma fromCounts_counts (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) : μ.fromCounts.counts = μ

name: Multiset.fromCounts_dedup
statement: lemma fromCounts_dedup (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) : μ.fromCounts.dedup = range μ.card

name: Multiset.fromCounts_eq_nil_iff
statement:
lemma fromCounts_eq_nil_iff (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    μ.fromCounts.toList = [] ↔ μ.toList = []

name: Multiset.fromCounts_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma fromCounts_eq_zero_iff (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    μ.fromCounts = 0 ↔ μ = 0

name: Multiset.fromCounts_remove_card
statement:
lemma fromCounts_remove_card (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    (μ.fromCounts.remove 0).toFinset.card = μ.card - 1

name: Multiset.fromCounts_singleton
statement:
lemma fromCounts_singleton {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ({n} : Multiset ℕ).fromCounts = Multiset.replicate n 0

name: Multiset.fromCounts_sorted
statement:
lemma fromCounts_sorted (μ : Multiset ℕ) : List.Pairwise (· ≥ ·) <|
    List.map (fun n => Multiset.count n μ.fromCounts) (List.range μ.card)

name: Multiset.fromCounts_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma fromCounts_zero : fromCounts 0 = 0

name: Multiset.map_count_fromCounts
statement:
lemma map_count_fromCounts (μ : Multiset ℕ) :
    List.map (fun n ↦ count n μ.fromCounts) (List.range μ.card) = μ.sort (· ≥ ·)

name: Multiset.mem_fromCounts
statement:
lemma mem_fromCounts (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < μ.card) :
    n ∈ μ.fromCounts

name: Multiset.mem_fromCounts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_fromCounts_iff {n : ℕ} (h0 : 0 ∉ μ) :
    n ∈ μ.fromCounts ↔ n < μ.card

name: Multiset.ne_zero_of_fromCounts_ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_fromCounts_ne_zero (hμ : μ.fromCounts ≠ 0) : μ ≠ 0

name: Multiset.notMem_fromCounts
statement:
lemma notMem_fromCounts (μ : Multiset ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ μ.card) :
    n ∉ μ.fromCounts

name: Multiset.zero_mem_fromCounts_of_nonempty
statement: lemma zero_mem_fromCounts_of_nonempty (hμ : μ.fromCounts ≠ 0) : 0 ∈ μ.fromCounts

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.col_le_entry
statement: lemma col_le_entry {i j : ℕ} (h : (i, j) ∈ γ) (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) : i ≤ T i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.entry_eq_zero_of_bot
statement: lemma entry_eq_zero_of_bot (T : SemistandardYoungTableau γ) {i j : ℕ} (h : γ = ⊥) : T i j = 0

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.max_triple
statement:
@[simp] lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.max_triple {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    ({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).toList.max (by simp) = a

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.min_triple
statement:
@[simp] lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.min_triple {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    ({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).toList.min (by simp) = c

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sort_pair_ge
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sort_pair_ge {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) : ({a, b} : Multiset ℕ).sort (· ≥ ·) = [a, b]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sort_triple_ge
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sort_triple_ge {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    (({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).sort (· ≥ ·)) = [a, b, c]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sort_triple_le
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sort_triple_le {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    (({a, b, c} : Multiset ℕ).sort (· ≤ ·)) = [c, b, a]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sorted_pair
statement: lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sorted_pair {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≥ b) : List.SortedGE [a, b]

name: Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sorted_triple
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Kostkanumbers.sorted_triple {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≥ b) (hbc : b ≥ c) :
    List.SortedGE [a, b, c]
